messages:
rekha_support: FYI customer (maria@acme.io) reports they were charged twice for today's subscription renewal. Two invoices show up on their PO/AP side: INV-2026-0042 and INV-2026-0043, both $5,000. Account acct_0Hk... Customer says PO #PO-889 was on file and they expected invoice-only, not a charge. Attached screenshot. /cc @oliver_finance

kevin_support: ACK. Can you paste invoice links and payment IDs? Any screenshot of the billing portal would help.

rekha_support: invoice links: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0042 and https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0043. Payment tx IDs: ch_3KJabc and ch_3KJdef. Customer note: "we only approved the invoice, AP hasn't released payment — PO should have prevented capture".

billing_bot: stripe_event: invoice.paid (id=evt_1Jxyz, invoice=INV-2026-0042) 2026-03-15T14:02:31Z
stripe_event: invoice.paid (id=evt_1Jxyy, invoice=INV-2026-0043) 2026-03-15T14:02:33Z
note: duplicate webhook retry detected, idempotency key not present on second delivery.

julian_engineer: quick read: looks like two invoice.paid events got processed as separate captures. Suspect webhook consumer didn't dedupe by event.id or idempotency_key. Quick repro check (internal):
```
GET /internal/billing/invoices?account=acct_0Hk
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $INT_TOKEN" "https://internal.redwood/api/billing/invoices?account=acct_0Hk"
```
This should show both invoice records and payment IDs.

oliver_finance: If both charges captured we need to refund the duplicate and issue a credit note. Customer requests refund. Recommend refund INV-2026-0043 / charge ch_3KJdef (the later capture). I'll need GL code 5200-BILL and approval recorded in FIN ticket. I'll create credit note CN-2026-112 and reversal entry.

kevin_support: Customer authorized refund. @oliver_finance please proceed. Rekha — confirm amount and card last4.

rekha_support: Confirming: duplicate amount $5,000, card last4 4242. Refund target ch_3KJdef (INV-2026-0043). Customer also asked for a corrected invoice (void duplicate and attach credit note).

oliver_finance: Initiating refund in Stripe now. Refund id rf_5LD9cn created for $5,000 -> ch_3KJdef. Credit note CN-2026-112 generated and applied to INV-2026-0043 (voided). ETA for funds back to customer: 5-10 business days. Created FIN ticket FIN-4321 for audit trail.

rekha_support: Draft reply to customer:
"Hi Maria — we've identified a duplicate charge and initiated a full refund of $5,000 (REF: rf_5LD9cn). You should see the refund in 5–10 business days. Invoice INV-2026-0043 has been voided and replaced with credit note CN-2026-112. Apologies for the inconvenience. If you need a formal reversal letter for PO, we can provide one. Let me know if you need anything else."
Thoughts?

kevin_support: LGTM. Add note that this will not change their subscription renewal schedule; we'll mark the account so PO flow prevents auto-charge until AP confirms.

julian_engineer: I'll deploy a hotfix to webhook consumer this afternoon: dedupe on stripe event.id and honor idempotency_key if present. After patch I'll run a quick reprocess check to ensure we don't have historical duplicates left open. Monitor logs for duplicate invoice.paid events.

oliver_finance: Quick tax check: customer is EU (VAT-DE-993) — confirm VAT amounts on corrected invoice before sending final pdf. Rekha please confirm VAT number on account.

rekha_support: Confirmed VAT-DE-993. I'll attach corrected invoice PDF with proper tax line and the credit note.

billing_bot: FIN-4321 updated: refund:rf_5LD9cn, credit_note:CN-2026-112, event_root:evt_1Jxyz

rekha_support: Closing loop with customer now. Will re-open if they report no refund after 10 business days. :white_check_mark:
